name: Tequila Old Fashioned
desc: The Camp infusion kit with tequila instead of bourbon, three days in the fridge

ingredients.raw: 1 Camp Old Fashioned infusion kit (sugar, bitters, orange and cherry)
ingredients.item: Camp Old Fashioned infusion kit (sugar, bitters, orange and cherry)

ingredients.raw: A large ice cube, to serve
A small squeeze of lime, to serve

steps: Pour the tequila into the Camp kit jar over the botanicals. Blanco works, but the aged stuff brings a warmth that suits the bitters and sugar.
Seal and refrigerate 3 days. The kit supplies the sugar and bitters, so nothing else goes in.
Serve over a large ice cube with a small squeeze of lime. Tequila wants acidity in a way bourbon does not, and it brightens the whole drink.
